text:
maria: Heads-up — profiler + heap snapshots from the long-context test (50k tokens, 2h drift) show steady KV cache fragmentation and memory growth. peak_rss up ~18% vs baseline.
leo: Can you drop the trace and a short summary? which allocator metrics spike?
maria: Pasted top-level numbers from the run: free_block_count: 812 -> 490 over 90m, small_hole_pct: 41%, large_hole_pct: 6%, avg_hole_size: 3.6KB. Hotset churn high for some slabs. Seems blocks are freed but not coalesced/reused efficiently.
sam: Seen this on ded-dev too. My hunch: allocator prefers same-size buckets which leads to many tiny holes that don't fit incoming long-kv writes, so we keep allocating new large blocks instead of reusing.
tessa: That aligns with the trace I ran — long contexts create many >12KB KV entries intermittently. If the allocator keeps fixed bucket sizes, we get internal fragmentation.
maria: Proposal sketch: dynamic shrink/grow + opportunistic local repack. Two levers: (1) hybrid bucket policy (best-fit for >=16KB, pooled-fit for <16KB) and (2) background local repack that coalesces adjacent free runs within a slab when small_hole_pct > 30%.
leo: Background repack is fine but we must cap latency/CPU. Can we do incremental repack slices (e.g. 50 slab ops/s) + preemptible by request thread?
sam: Did a small benchmark today: local_repack (slice 60 ops/s) on a 2h replay. Memory dropped ~12% after 20min of repack, throughput hit -4% during active repack window, p95 +8ms in worst windows. Acceptable if we gate it to low-util windows or a canary.
tessa: Would prefer a config surface so ops can tune: trigger thresholds, max_pause_ms, slab_scan_rate, hybrid thresholds. Also expose metrics so console can alert on regressions.
maria: Draft config (proto):
```
kv.compaction:
  mode: local_repack
  trigger_free_frac: 0.30
  max_pause_ms: 120
  slab_scan_rate: 50/s
kv.allocator:
  hybrid_mode: true
  small_block_sizes: [256, 1024, 4096]
  large_block_threshold: 16384
  aggressive_coalesce: false
```
leo: Looks good. Two concerns: rollback story if it regresses, and the perf signal in CI.
sam: CI note — I ran canary on 10% of dedicated pool; attached script used `replay-kv-workload --seed=longctx --duration=2h`. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/kv-repack-2026-03-17 (will post full artifacts). Results captured: mem_vs_time.csv, latency_percentiles.json.
tessa: Ops/Console changes: add kv.fragmentation_ratio, kv.repack_runs_total, kv.repack_pause_ms. Add alert if fragmentation_ratio > 0.35 for >10m.
ci-bot: perf-run queued: job_id=87231, link=https://ci.internal/runs/87231, scheduled at 2026-03-18T08:00:00Z
maria: Action items: 1) eng-runtime: implement hybrid allocator flag + small block pools (owner: sam, ETA: 2 weeks) 2) infra: add background repack runner with slice rate + safety caps (owner: leo, ETA: 3 weeks) 3) devex: dashboard metrics + alert (owner: tessa, ETA: 1 week) 4) run 10% canary on Dedicated, collect mem/latency artifacts (owner: sam/leo)
leo: I'll prototype the slice scheduler into the compactor and add a kill switch env var.
sam: I'll prepare the canary run and baseline artifacts.
tessa: I'll add the metrics to Console and a dashboard stub; will also wire an alert.
maria: Great — let's sync after first canary run. :eyes:
